turns.q: How long does it normally take to ship and send a tracking number?
turns.replyTail:
a tracking number?

Hi — normally orders ship out in 1–3 business days, and tracking is usually sent once the shipping label is created. After that, delivery is typically another 4–8 business days.

So in most cases:

Standard orders: 5–11 business days total
Personalized orders: 10–16 business days total

Orders usually arrive on the earlier end of that window 🙂 You can also check our shipping details here: shipping page

Let me know if there’s anything else I can help with!

turns.q: Can I reroute the package to a different address?
turns.replyTail:
ute the package to a different address?

Hi — if the order hasn’t shipped yet and it was placed very recently, you may still be able to update the shipping address through the “Edit or View your order” button in your order confirmation email. 📦

If it’s already shipped, we usually can’t reroute it from chat. In that case, check the tracking link for any carrier delivery options.

If you want, send your order number that starts with SM and I’ll tell you which situation applies.
